topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I heard the news like a sudden rain, heavy drops on the thatch, unexpected and hard to bear. My friend, the one who’s always been at my side like a steadfast stone in the stream, is leaving. Moving, they say, to a place where the fields are unfamiliar and the skies are wide as our dreams. I think about the times we’ve shared, the laughter and the silences, and it feels as if the earth has shifted beneath my feet. But I know, just as I know the seasons, that this, too, will pass. The wind changes, but the roots of the old oak hold firm. We will find our way, for the soil of our friendship is deep and strong.
